content.text: Add shareable PR & Neatlogs trace evidence endpoints (/runs/{run_id}/share and /api/runs/{run_id}/pr-evidence) with Entire-Graph blast-radius callers and AWS Lambda SHA-256 attestation.

Implemented /runs/{run_id}/share and /api/runs/{run_id}/pr-evidence in server.py to export self-contained HTML and Markdown PR evidence bundles containing Neatlogs span ledgers, Entire-Graph caller maps, and AWS Lambda SHA-256 certificates; verified 13/13 pytest suite.
